notes.title: "Tyrano Studio - System UI Skin Plugin" Now Available
notes.notes:
[p][b]"Tyrano Studio - System UI Skin Plugin" Now Available[/b][/p][p]We’ve released the [b]System UI Skin Plugin[/b], which allows you to instantly switch your game’s entire system UI with ease.[/p][p]The plugin includes [b]two different UI themes[/b] for you to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3849250/Tyrano_Studio__System_UI_Skin_Plugin_1/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3849260/Tyrano_Studio__System_UI_Skin_Plugin_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]While this is developed as a plugin for [b]TyranoScript[/b], the included assets can also be used with other tools and engines.[/p][p][/p][p]■ [b]Supported Screen Resolutions[/b]
・1920×1080px
・1280×720px[/p][p][/p][p]■ [b]How to Install the System UI Skin Plugin[/b]
After purchasing the DLC, restart [b]TyranoStudio[/b] to load the new content.
From the left-hand menu, select [b]“DLC”[/b] and choose the plugin to download and apply it.[/p][p]Once installed, simply add a tag to your script to switch all system UI elements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Example:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]; Enable the plugin  [/p][p]\[plugin name="theme_kopanda_22"][/p][p][/p][p]; Display system buttons  [/p][p]\[add_theme_button]  [/p][p][/p][p]That's it![/p][p][/p][p]For detailed installation instructions, please refer to the included file:
[b]How_to_Install_System_UI_Skin_Plugin.txt[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A step-by-step video guide is also available:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EzEFekFcXvo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Also, while the System UI Skin Plugin is designed for TyranoScript,[/p][p]it can also be easily used with TyranoBuilder.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6GoENLVf-Ss"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Please feel free to make use of it![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: TyranoStudio Updated V603
notes.notes:
TyranoStudio has been updated.

This update focuses on bug fixes and improvements related to the localization feature.

Fixed an issue where the localization feature would not work properly if scenario files were placed in deep folder hierarchies.

Added a feature that allows system-related messages to be localized.
